thread:
maria-sec: spotted sensitive artifacts in partner staging logs — vault token strings and a batch of KMS-wrapped ciphertexts in s3://partner-logs/staging/2026-03-20/ingest.log. marking as high-risk, not yet public.
devin-infra: Can you paste sanitized snippets and the exact S3 key so infra can snapshot?
maria-sec: redacted sample: `user=svc-dataflow token=vt.eyJhbGci... vault_path=secret/data/staging/legacy`
kevin-platform: tagging stopped for downstream replays. will pause any ingestion jobs referencing that prefix. running `aws s3api put-object-tagging ... --tagging 'TagSet=[{Key=incident,Value=hold}]'`.
rotor-bot: Reminder: create incident doc with template security/incident.
sam-oncall: Adding incident channel and paging oncall. Who can own the immediate rotation?
maria-sec: Initial containment plan: (1) disable the implicated approle/creds, (2) rotate affected service keys, (3) snapshot S3 for audit, (4) re-encrypt S3 objects that use deprecated KMS key.
devin-infra: Need two things ASAP: list all active leases in staging namespace, and find any usage of old KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:old-key.
maria-sec: running `vault list auth/approle/role` and `vault list sys/leases/lookup` now; also grepping logs for old-key.
kevin-platform: For re-encrypting, we'll require a role allowing kms:ReEncrypt from old-key to new-key. sketch policy: `{ "Action": ["kms:ReEncrypt*","kms:Decrypt","kms:Encrypt"], "Resource": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:old-key","arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:new-key"] }`. I'll provision a short-lived grant.
partner-eng: we're initiating index scrub with our vendor; ETA depends on their crawl cycle, will update in 30m.
maria-sec: blast-radius mitigations applied: revoked the approle binding, rotated staging svcacct keys, and requested partner scrub. collecting audit evidence.
devin-infra: replay jobs paused and S3 snapshot created at s3://partner-logs/snapshots/3123456789/ — preserving for postmortem.
kevin-platform: started rewrap job (batch 1/8) using aws kms re-encrypt with controlled concurrency. sample: `aws kms re-encrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --destination-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111:new-key`. Verification hooks running to ensure ciphertexts still validate.
maria-sec: also flagging Vault policy TTLs — staging had tokens with TTLs >7d. will propose enforcement to <=1h for staging roles after containment.
rotor-bot: Incident created: security/incident-3123 | owner: maria-sec.
sam-oncall: Please post short updates here every 30m. scheduling 1h sync to review containment and decide if partner creds need rotation.
partner-eng: scrub complete for external index; vendor ticket #SRE-4991 updated. verifying internal caches next.
maria-sec: rewrap finished, verification passed; no decryption anomalies. partner confirms scrubbed copies removed.
kevin-platform: removed temporary KMS grant and tightened IAM for re-encrypt to require EncryptionContext `{env:staging}`.
devin-infra: vault and CloudTrail logs archived to secure bucket with 90d retention for forensics.
maria-sec: follow-ups: run org-wide secret-sleuth for `secret/data/staging` and `old-key`, implement TTL enforcement, and add automated alerts for plaintext-like patterns in logs.
sam-oncall: thanks. closing containment phase, we'll draft a postmortem in ~24h. :thumbsup:
